_doc: Shared weather rates and looks (ADR-0033). Each state's own numbers (rain, snow, wind, gust, lightning, ground_fog, haze) are in data/weather/weather.json. Times are game minutes unless named _s (real seconds) or _m (metres).

wetness._doc: Surfaces soak through in wet_minutes of full rain and dry in dry_minutes of still, overcast air; sun (x sun_dry) and wind (x 1 + wind_dry * wind) dry them faster. Standing water starts once surfaces are soaked past puddle_after, fills in puddle_fill_minutes of full rain and drains or dries in puddle_dry_minutes.

snow._doc: Snow cover builds over build_minutes of full snowfall and melts over melt_minutes (melt_minutes_winter in winter); rain washes it away over rain_melt_minutes.

lightning._doc: Strikes are a pure function of the world seed and the game clock (LightningModel): each slot_minutes slot holds one with chance rate x slot / 60. A strike lands distance_m away (log-uniform: most are far), on a bearing and with 1..4 return strokes stroke_gap_s apart, each flashing for flash_s. The flash lights the cloud deck (sky_flash) and throws a hard shadow from the sky over the strike (light_energy, fading to nothing by light_far_m); a bolt is drawn in the sky within bolt_within_m. Thunder arrives distance / speed_of_sound real seconds later: a crack and rumble within thunder_near_m, a low roll beyond, from thunder_db[0] close by to thunder_db[1] at the far end.

precipitation._doc: Rain and snow drawn around the camera (WeatherFx, precipitation.gdshader). Drops and flakes at full strength by graphics preset, spawned in a camera-centred column box = [half-width, metres above, metres below]; they stop where the weather map says rain lands (roofs, ground, water) and rain splashes there. wind_push: metres per second of drift at full wind. Streaks are streak_length x streak_width metres; flakes flake_size metres across.

drips._doc: Drips from roof eaves: found on the weather map where a roof edge stands min_drop_m or more over open ground beside it, at most max_points around the camera within radius_m, each dripping rate times a second at full wetness (they keep dripping a while after the rain, as the roof drains).

fog._doc: Ground fog pools in hollows and over water at dawn and dusk. It gathers from dawn[0] hours after sunrise (negative: before), peaks at sunrise and burns off by dawn[1]; at dusk it gathers from sunset over dusk_hours to dusk_strength. Strength x the weather's ground_fog, fading as the wind rises past calm_wind. Near the camera it is a FogVolume whose density fills in below the local fog level (the low ground around, smoothed, plus depth_m; plus water_depth_m over water); far off it is the depth fog's height falloff (height_density) under the same level.

dust._doc: Dust motes hanging in the air indoors by day (seen where light shafts cross them): count in a box of [half-width, half-height] metres round the camera, each size metres across, drifting drift metres per second.

maps._doc: The weather map round the camera (WeatherMaps, shader global hm_weather_map): cells x cells of cell_m metres, rebuilt when the camera moves recentre_m from its centre. R = where rain lands (downward rays within the inner catch_cells, rays_per_frame a frame), G = the ground, B = the ground smoothed over hollow_m (puddles collect where the ground lies below it), A = the water surface.

surfaces._doc: Per terrain layer (data/materials/terrain_layers.json): puddle = how readily standing water collects on it (asphalt, mud and fen peat hold it, litter and sand drink it); porosity = how much darker it turns soaked (dirt, litter and wet ash darken most, sealed asphalt and peat, already near saturated, least).
